programs.title: Total Recall
programs.desc: Douglas Quaid is a bored construction worker in the year 2084 who dreams of visiting colonized Mars. He visits "Rekall," a company that plants false memories into people's brains, in order to experience the thrill of Mars without having to travel there. But something goes wrong during the procedure; Quaid discovers that his entire life is actually a false memory and that the people who implanted it in his head now want him dead.

programs.title: The Fifth Element
programs.desc: The Earth is about to be destroyed by a huge ball of fire racing toward the planet. Cornelius, an old monk, knows how to stop the burning sphere with the help of Korben Dallas, a taxi driver and former secret agent and a woman named Leeloo.

programs.title: The Running Man
programs.desc: In the year 2019, America is a totalitarian state where the favorite television program is "The Running Man" -- a game show in which prisoners must run to freedom to avoid a brutal death. Having been made a scapegoat by the government, an imprisoned Ben Richards (Arnold Schwarzenegger) has the opportunity to make it back to the outside again by being a contestant on the deadly show, although the twisted host, Damon Killian (Richard Dawson), has no intention of letting him escape.

programs.title: Law & Order
programs.desc: A former senator becomes a suspect when his ex-wife is found dead at her home the night after attending a fundraiser with the family.

programs.title: Law & Order
programs.desc: Detective Cyrus Lupo leaves terrorist regions to return to his own family terror at home.

programs.title: Law & Order
programs.desc: During a blackout, a panic-button alert sends detectives Green and Lupo to the home of a high-level executive, whose wife and daughter are missing and whose housekeeper has been murdered.
